_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits in Denial (32-38) and the 7-day base rate shows 97% of 12h windows held ±2 points — this is a textbook coil where HOLD with conviction is the statistically honest call until either ETF flows resume or momentum breaks down further.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst forward call is HOLD (coil, no capital), narrative forward call is effectively LONG (mean reversion imminent); the split is whether the broken ETF-flow analog still has predictive power.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows turn positive for 2+ consecutive sessions while price holds current range
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows remain at zero AND Fear & Greed drops below 24 (Panic band), which would shift the phase down a rung and invalidate the bottom analog entirely
